quiz.q: Which equation has vertex (−3,2), opens down, and is narrower than y=x2?哪个方程的顶点是 (−3,2)、开口向下、且比 y=x2 窄？
opts: y=−2(x−3)2+2
y=2(x+3)2+2
y=−21​(x+3)2+2
y=−2(x+3)2+2
quiz.hint: Check three things separately: sign inside the bracket, sign of a, size of ∣a∣.分三项检查：括号内符号、a 的符号、∣a∣ 的大小。
quiz.why: Correct: p=−3, q=2, a=−2 (negative, ∣a∣>1).正确：p=−3，q=2，a=−2（负数且 ∣a∣>1）。
whys: Sign of p: (x−3)2 puts the vertex at x=3, not −3.p 的符号错了：(x−3)2 的顶点在 x=3，不是 −3。
a=2>0 opens up; opening down needs a<0.a=2>0 开口向上；开口向下要 a<0。
∣a∣=21​<1 makes the graph wider, not narrower.∣a∣=21​<1 让图象变宽，不是变窄。
Correct: p=−3, q=2, a=−2 (negative, ∣a∣>1).正确：p=−3，q=2，a=−2（负数且 ∣a∣>1）。

quiz.q: A parabola has vertex (2,−8) and passes through (4,0). What are its x-intercepts?抛物线顶点为 (2,−8)，且过 (4,0)。它的 x 截距是什么？
opts: 4 only只有 4
0 and 40 和 4
−8 and 4−8 和 4
−2 and 2−2 和 2
quiz.hint: The axis is x=2, so the known zero 4 has a mirror zero at 0.对称轴是 x=2，已知零点 4 的镜像零点是 0。
quiz.why: Correct: a=(4−2)20+8​=2; 2(x−2)2=8⇒x−2=±2⇒x=0,4.正确：a=(4−2)20+8​=2；2(x−2)2=8⇒x−2=±2⇒x=0,4。
whys: Forgot the mirror point: every zero has a partner the same distance on the other side of x=2.忘了对称点：每个零点在 x=2 另一侧等距处都有一个对应零点。
Correct: a=(4−2)20+8​=2; 2(x−2)2=8⇒x−2=±2⇒x=0,4.正确：a=(4−2)20+8​=2；2(x−2)2=8⇒x−2=±2⇒x=0,4。
Mixed up heights and intercepts: −8 is the lowest value of y (the vertex height), not a place where the graph crosses the x-axis.把高度和截距弄混了：−8 是 y 的最小值（顶点的高度），不是图象与 x 轴的交点。
Dropped p: solved x2=4 instead of (x−2)2=4.漏了 p：解了 x2=4 而不是 (x−2)2=4。

quiz.q: State the vertex, axis of symmetry and range of y=3(x−4)2+1.写出 y=3(x−4)2+1 的顶点、对称轴和值域。
quiz.hint: a=3>0 opens up.a=3>0，开口向上。
quiz.ans: vertex (4,1), axis x=4, range y≥1顶点 (4,1)，对称轴 x=4，值域 y≥1
quiz.why: p=4, q=1; opens up so the range is y≥1.p=4，q=1；开口向上，值域 y≥1。

quiz.q: How many x-intercepts does y=−2(x−1)2+8 have? Find them.y=−2(x−1)2+8 有几个 x 截距？求出它们。
quiz.hint: a<0, q>0. Then set y=0 and isolate the square.a<0，q>0。再令 y=0，把平方项单独留在一边。
quiz.ans: Two: x=−1 and x=3两个：x=−1 和 x=3
quiz.why: 2(x−1)2=8⇒(x−1)2=4⇒x−1=±2.2(x−1)2=8⇒(x−1)2=4⇒x−1=±2。

quiz.q: A gondola cable hangs between two towers 80 m apart. Each tower top is 36 m above the valley floor, and the lowest point of the cable, midway between the towers, is 4 m above the floor. Put the origin on the floor under the left tower and model the cable as a parabola. (a) Write its equation in vertex form. (b) At what horizontal distances from the left tower is the cable 12 m above the floor? (c) Explain why those two distances must add to 80.一条缆车钢缆挂在相距 80 m 的两座塔之间。每座塔顶离谷底 36 m，钢缆最低点在两塔正中间，离谷底 4 m。以左塔正下方的谷底为原点，把钢缆看成抛物线。(a) 写出顶点式方程。(b) 离左塔多远的地方，钢缆离谷底 12 m？(c) 解释为什么这两个距离的和必为 80。
quiz.hint: The lowest point is the vertex (40,4); a tower top such as (0,36) gives a.最低点是顶点 (40,4)；塔顶 (0,36) 可求出 a。
quiz.ans: y=0.02(x−40)2+4; x=20 and x=60; they are mirror images about x=40y=0.02(x−40)2+4；x=20 和 x=60；两者关于 x=40 对称
quiz.why: The vertex is midway at x=40, height 4: y=a(x−40)2+4.顶点在正中间 x=40、高度 4：y=a(x−40)2+4。
